posts.title: Raspberry Pi Pico NeoPixel
posts.description: This was a quick experiment with CircuitPython controlling a few LEDs. I cut off 8 LEDs from a WS2812 strip, then glued them and a Raspberry Pi Pico to the back of a phone box as a test platform. It’s a fun way to experiment with Python on embedded hardware and get some immediate feedback […]
